prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Pet Personality", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "label": "Live Pet Preview", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a dedicated tutorial screen right after home_intro explaining how to interact, move, and hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls"], "new_pet_controls": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Drag to move your pet around screens, right-click to open options or hide, and double-click to chat.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Desktop Interactions Overview", "style": "plain", "action": "next"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It!", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Display Recovery Flow: Add interactive display troubleshooting and tip carousel to the waiting screen if rendering takes longer than expected.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Troubleshoot Desktop View", "style": "subtle", "action": "open_tip"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "If pet does not appear on your desktop, ensure display permissions are enabled.", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in connects your pet securely so your customized pet is never lost."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Update the headline and body of choose_path to explain quick pre-made pet adoption versus custom photo creation clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-play companion in seconds or upload photos to craft a unique custom pet."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout Photo Upload Guidelines: Switch upload_photos screen to stage layout with clear photo quality sample picker components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"role": "photo_upload", "type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Well-Lit Frontal Photo", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Generating Desktop Animations...", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Celebration: Add an animated celebratory pet mascot and official badge on the adoption certificate screen.

verdicts.reason: Redesigns pick_friend into a split view while preserving pet selection functionality.
Adds a new tutorial screen after home_intro without removing required steps.
Reorders sign_in to after adoption_certificate, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Adds display troubleshooting tips to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.
Adds an account preservation hint to the sign_in screen without violating rules.
Updates choose_path copy while retaining both adoption and creation options.
Redesigns upload_photos layout while preserving photo selection functionality.
Adds realistic time estimates and status badges to the waiting screen.
Adds a celebration mascot and official certification badge to the adoption certificate.
Enables readiness notifications and supportive guidance on the home_intro screen.
